A man who asks Allah's protection from Satan, in Allah's name, before intercourse with his wife will have any child destined from it safe from Satan's harm.
Anas said the Prophet visited all his wives, eleven or by another report nine, in one round, day and night, and companions said he had the strength of thirty.
Anas said the Prophet visited all his wives in one night, when he had nine wives.
A wife who refuses her husband's call to bed, so that he sleeps angry, is cursed by the angels till morning.
On 'your wives are a tilth', Ibn Umar spoke of how a man may approach his wife; Jabir said it answered a Jewish saying about intercourse from the back.
Saying Allah's name and asking protection from Satan when having intercourse with one's wife keeps Satan from harming any child destined from it.
A wife should not fast voluntarily without her husband's leave when he is home, nor admit anyone without his leave, and angels curse a wife refusing his bed until morning.
Do not flog a wife like a slave then lie with her; Allah curses women lengthening hair artificially, even at a husband's wish; a wife facing divorce may waive rights.
Companions practised coitus interruptus while the Quran was being revealed, including with female captives, and the Prophet says every soul destined to exist will come into existence.
The Prophet forbade laughing at someone who passes wind, and asked how a man can beat his wife like a stallion camel and then embrace her.
